answer.chase_next: I would try to reach Minister, or at least stay in politics, by declining the Board Seat and see whether the ceiling really is fixed. I would also test whether the Y3 leaker and the tender story pay off if I play them differently.
answer.play_again_why: The ending soured it. I want to know my choices change something before I put in another 13 years. The early game had good moments, but I would want a hint that the ceiling is not fixed.
